description: Source code implementing socket options configuration functions for different platforms, including setting TCP no delay, reuse address, buffer sizes, and IPv6 only options.

methods.name: SetTCPNoDelay
methods.description: Sets the TCP_NODELAY option on a socket to disable/enable Nagle's algorithm.

methods.name: SetReuseAddr
methods.description: Sets the SO_REUSEADDR option to allow reusing local addresses.

methods.name: SetSocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: SetSocketSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for a socket.

methods.name: SetIPv6Only
methods.description: Sets the IPV6_V6ONLY option for IPv6 sockets.
